name: popnow-mcp
description: Create images, videos, music, voiceovers, ads, explainers, 3D models and browser games with your PopNow account, right in Claude Code. Connects the PopNow MCP server (OAuth sign-in, no API key) and adds skills that pick the right tool, show the price in credits and wait for your yes.
